The reorganization is complete and verified via `javac` compilation against the built classpath. Here's a summary of what was done:

## Class moves (git detected all three as renames)

| Class | From (`hudi-common`) | To (`hudi-hadoop-common`) |
|---|---|---|
| `HFileBootstrapIndex` | `common.bootstrap.index` | `common.bootstrap.index.hfile` |
| `HoodieHFileUtils` | `io.storage` | `io.hadoop` |
| `HoodieHBaseAvroHFileReader` | `io.storage` | `io.hadoop` |

## Constructor simplification

`HoodieHBaseAvroHFileReader` now exposes exactly the two requested `CacheConfig`-free public constructors, which build the `CacheConfig` internally from the `StorageConfiguration`:
- `HoodieHBaseAvroHFileReader(StorageConfiguration<?>, StoragePath, Option<Schema>)`
- `HoodieHBaseAvroHFileReader(StorageConfiguration<?>, StoragePath, HoodieStorage, byte[], Option<Schema>)`

The old `CacheConfig`-taking constructors were removed and consolidated into a single private canonical constructor.

## Supporting changes

- **`HoodieAvroHFileReaderImplBase`**: made nested `SeekableByteArrayInputStream` `public` so `HoodieHFileUtils` can reference it from its new package (it now references it via the base class).
- **`HoodieAvroFileReaderFactory`**: dropped `CacheConfig`/`Configuration`/`HoodieStorageUtils` usage and imports; calls the new constructors (`HoodieHBaseAvroHFileReader` is now a same-package neighbor).
- **Import/FQN updates for all callers**:
  - `HoodieStreamer`, `HoodieBootstrapConfig` → import updated to the `hfile` subpackage (both modules depend on `hudi-hadoop-common`).
  - `BootstrapCommand` → default `--bootstrapIndexClass` string updated.
  - `BootstrapIndexType`, `HoodieTableConfig` (in `hudi-common`, which **cannot** depend on `hudi-hadoop-common`) → replaced `HFileBootstrapIndex.class.getName()` with the hardcoded FQN string `"org.apache.hudi.common.bootstrap.index.hfile.HFileBootstrapIndex"`. This is safe because the index is instantiated reflectively at runtime from the classpath.

No files under `tests/` were touched. Compilation of all moved and modified source files passes (the only earlier `javac` error was a pre-existing UTF-8 apostrophe in `HoodieTableConfig` unrelated to this change).
